name: thimble
description: thimble: notebook-backed analysis of agent runs inside a Claude Code session. Its plugin, thimble, is sourced from ./plugin of this tree (its version is plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json's).

plugins.name: thimble
plugins.description: Turns a Claude Code session into an analyst workbench over the agent transcripts in the working directory: the thimble MCP tools, its hooks, the /thimble skill and the `thimble` launcher. Needs the thimble server installed beside it (scripts/install.sh).
